## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 6854 invited people. Of these, 4756 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 69.4 per cent.

The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and attendance received during the reporting period. They are presented together to support a clear comparison between the number of people invited and the number who attended.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 5768 invitees. A reminder was sent to 5277 people. These figures record the reported volume of SMS and reminder activity associated with the outreach.

The contact figures are provided alongside the invitation and attendance information to support monitoring of engagement. Further follow-up can be considered where appropriate, based on local operational arrangements and available contact information.

Prepared by G. Evans.
